decisions.reason: The image requirement already applies to every blog article, so increasing the article count does not change its current state.
The source increases the number of blogs but does not change the existing internal-link rules, destinations, or publication condition.
Requesting two additional blogs does not necessarily alter the selected keywords or keyword replacement rule.
The source changes the blog quantity but does not request or define a change to the topic-suggestion workflow.
The additional blog count does not change the campaign keyword count or selected campaign keyword mapping.
The source does not modify the requested coverage or form of the on-page SEO progress report.
The request for two additional blogs does not change the weekly report type or Friday delivery schedule.
The source changes only the blog article count and does not affect backlink quantity or follow-type percentages.
The source concerns additional blog production and does not alter the separate webpage content update requirement.
